title: `topics/sherrington-dualist-lineage` assigns "not merely unsolved, but still devoid of a basis for its very beginning" to the 1947 *Integrative Action* foreword, where it does not occur (raw OCR: 0 hits); it is from the 1950 BBC symposium *The Physical Basis of Mind*, quoted back at Sherrington by a later contributor (p. 69); the foreword's actual concession and three never-used foreword passages should replace it
